import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
UA={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
BL62="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
ls=BL62.strip().split("\n"); hdr=ls[0].split(); BL={}
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for j,v in enumerate(p[1:]): BL[(p[0],hdr[j])]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return BL.get((a,b),BL.get((b,a),-4))
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    PM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);PX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);PY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(a,s2[j-1])
            c=(M[i-1,j-1],X[i-1,j-1],Y[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(c));M[i,j]=c[k]+s;PM[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge,Y[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(c));X[i,j]=c[k];PX[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i,j-1]+go,X[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(c));Y[i,j]=c[k];PY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]))); A=[];B=[];P=(PM,PX,PY)
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: st=2
        elif j==0: st=1
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append(s2[j-1]);ns=P[0][i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append('-');ns=P[1][i,j];i-=1
        else: A.append('-');B.append(s2[j-1]);ns=P[2][i,j];j-=1
        st=ns
    return "".join(A[::-1]),"".join(B[::-1])
def fa(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",headers=UA,timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.strip().split("\n")[1:])
REF=fa("A8DZ15"); L=len(REF)

cj=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniref/UniRef50_A0A0P8Y319",headers=UA,timeout=60).json()
mem=[cj.get("representativeMember")]+cj.get("members",[])
seen={"A8DZ15"}; orth=[]
for m in mem:
    if not isinstance(m,dict): continue
    acc=m.get("memberId") or (m.get("accessions") or [None])[0]
    org=m.get("organismName","")
    if not acc or acc in seen: continue
    seen.add(acc)
    s=fa(acc)
    if len(s)<250 or len(s)>400: continue   # drop short fragments
    orth.append((acc,org,s))
print("orthologs used:",len(orth))
for a,o,s in orth: print("  ",a,o.split(" (")[0],len(s))

hits=np.zeros(L); tot=np.zeros(L)
for acc,org,s in orth:
    A,B=nw(REF,s); i=0
    for ca_,cb in zip(A,B):
        if ca_!='-':
            tot[i]+=1
            if ca_==cb: hits[i]+=1
            i+=1
identity=np.where(tot>0,hits/np.maximum(tot,1),np.nan)

pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-A8DZ15-F1-model_v6.pdb",headers=UA,timeout=90).text
at=[(l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]))
    for l in pdb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM")]
atoms=pd.DataFrame(at,columns=["name","res","num","x","y","z"])
RAD={"C":1.70,"N":1.55,"O":1.52,"S":1.80}
atoms["r"]=[RAD.get(n[0],1.7) for n in atoms["name"]]
XYZ=atoms[["x","y","z"]].values; R=atoms["r"].values+1.4
N=200; gi=np.pi*(3-np.sqrt(5)); k=np.arange(N)
zz=1-2*k/(N-1); rr=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-zz**2)); th=gi*k
SPH=np.stack([rr*np.cos(th),rr*np.sin(th),zz],1)
tree=cKDTree(XYZ); area=np.zeros(len(atoms))
for i in range(len(atoms)):
    pts=XYZ[i]+SPH*R[i]
    nb=[q for q in tree.query_ball_point(XYZ[i],R[i]+R.max()) if q!=i]
    acc=np.ones(N,bool)
    if nb:
        d=np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-XYZ[nb][None,:,:],axis=2)
        acc=~(d<R[nb][None,:]).any(1)
    area[i]=4*np.pi*R[i]**2*acc.mean()
atoms["sasa"]=area
MAXA={"A":129,"R":274,"N":195,"D":193,"C":167,"Q":225,"E":223,"G":104,"H":224,"I":197,"L":201,
      "K":236,"M":224,"F":240,"P":159,"S":155,"T":172,"W":285,"Y":263,"V":174}
T3={"ALA":"A","ARG":"R","ASN":"N","ASP":"D","CYS":"C","GLN":"Q","GLU":"E","GLY":"G","HIS":"H","ILE":"I",
    "LEU":"L","LYS":"K","MET":"M","PHE":"F","PRO":"P","SER":"S","THR":"T","TRP":"W","TYR":"Y","VAL":"V"}
g=atoms.groupby("num").agg(res=("res","first"),sasa=("sasa","sum"))
rsa=np.full(L,np.nan)
for num,row in g.iterrows(): rsa[num-1]=row.sasa/MAXA[T3[row.res]]
cadf=atoms[atoms.name=="CA"].set_index("num")[["x","y","z"]]
f222=cadf.loc[222].values
dist=np.array([np.linalg.norm(cadf.loc[i+1].values-f222) for i in range(L)])

dom=np.array([(38<=i+1<=265) for i in range(L)])
ok=dom&~np.isnan(identity)&~np.isnan(rsa)
bur=ok&(rsa<=0.25); sur=ok&(rsa>0.25)
u1,p1=mannwhitneyu(identity[bur],identity[sur],alternative='greater')
print(f"\nburied n={bur.sum()} mean={identity[bur].mean():.3f} | surface n={sur.sum()} mean={identity[sur].mean():.3f} U={u1:.0f} p={p1:.3g}")
near=sur&(dist<=14); far=sur&(dist>14)
u2,p2=mannwhitneyu(identity[near],identity[far],alternative='greater')
pool=np.sqrt((identity[near].var(ddof=1)*(near.sum()-1)+identity[far].var(ddof=1)*(far.sum()-1))/(near.sum()+far.sum()-2))
dd=(identity[near].mean()-identity[far].mean())/pool
print(f"near F222 n={near.sum()} mean={identity[near].mean():.3f} | far n={far.sum()} mean={identity[far].mean():.3f} U={u2:.0f} p={p2:.3g} d={dd:.2f}")
print("\nper-position RSA / ortholog identity:")
for lab,pos in [("H72 (chymo 57)",72),("D124 (102)",124),("Q216 (189)",216),("T220 (193)",220),
                ("F222 (195)",222),("A236 (214)",236),("G238 (216)",238),("V248 (226)",248)]:
    print(f"  {lab:18s} RSA={rsa[pos-1]:.2f}  id={identity[pos-1]:.2f}  ({REF[pos-1]})")

rb=requests.get("https://www.bgee.org/api/",params={"page":"gene","action":"expression","gene_id":"FBgn0085200",
    "species_id":"7227","display_type":"json","data_type":"all"},headers=UA,timeout=90)
calls=rb.json()["data"]["calls"]
rows=[((c.get("condition",{}).get("anatEntity") or {}).get("name"),(c.get("expressionScore") or {}).get("expressionScore")) for c in calls]
B=pd.DataFrame([(a,float(s)) for a,s in rows if a and s],columns=["tissue","score"]).groupby("tissue")["score"].max().sort_values()
print("\nBgee expression score, %d calls:"%len(calls)); print(B.to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,4.9))
rs=np.random.RandomState(0); a=ax[0]
a.scatter(rsa[ok],identity[ok]+rs.normal(0,.012,ok.sum()),s=18,c=np.where(rsa[ok]>0.25,'#dd6b20','#2c5282'),alpha=.7)
for lab,p,c in [("H72",72,'#2f855a'),("D124",124,'#2f855a'),("Q216 (189)",216,'#c53030'),
                ("T220 (193)",220,'#c53030'),("F222 (195)",222,'#c53030'),("V248 (226)",248,'#c53030')]:
    a.scatter([rsa[p-1]],[identity[p-1]],s=95,marker='D',facecolor='none',edgecolor=c,lw=1.8)
    a.annotate(lab,(rsa[p-1],identity[p-1]),fontsize=7.5,xytext=(5,4),textcoords='offset points')
a.axvline(.25,ls='--',c='grey',lw=.8)
a.set_xlabel("relative solvent accessibility (AlphaFold)"); a.set_ylabel("identity across %d Drosophila orthologs"%len(orth))
a.set_title("Buried residues are conserved, surface are not\nMann-Whitney p = %.1e"%p1,fontsize=10)
b=ax[1]
b.scatter(dist[sur],identity[sur]+rs.normal(0,.012,sur.sum()),s=20,c='#dd6b20',alpha=.75)
b.axvline(14,ls='--',c='grey',lw=.8)
b.set_xlabel("CA distance from Phe222 (A)"); b.set_ylabel("ortholog identity")
b.set_title("Surface conservation near the dead active site\n%.2f (n=%d) vs %.2f (n=%d), p = %.3f, Cohen d = %.2f"%(
    identity[near].mean(),near.sum(),identity[far].mean(),far.sum(),p2,dd),fontsize=10)
c=ax[2]
c.barh(range(len(B)),B.values,color=['#c53030' if t in ("testis","male reproductive gland") else '#2c5282' for t in B.index])
c.set_yticks(range(len(B))); c.set_yticklabels(B.index,fontsize=8)
c.set_xlabel("Bgee expression score (max per tissue)")
c.set_title("CG34171 expression in D. melanogaster (Bgee)\ntop: Malpighian tubule, gut, trachea, testis; fat body lowest",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
